classes.name: Stakeholder
classes.definition: An abstract party that takes part in the Airport CDM process and originates or receives its information.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifying name of the stakeholder.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role played in the CDM process.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator that submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides TOBT and other operational inputs for a flight.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that carries out ground handling operations and, jointly with or in place of the Aircraft Operator, provides TOBT, ARDT and other turn-round inputs.

classes.name: ATCUnit
classes.definition: An Air Traffic Control unit that receives the flight plan, issues TSAT, grants start-up approval, and detects milestones via ATC systems.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function (e.g. via IFPS/ETFMS) that issues the CTOT, monitors flight progress, and receives DPI/FUM messages.

classes.name: AircraftCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and crew who request start-up and coordinate with the Ground Handler during the turn-round.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single arrival or departure operation of an aircraft, tracked through the sixteen milestones with an operational status and associated time quantities.

attributes.name: flightNumber
attributes.description: Identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is an arrival or a departure, as part of an aircraft turn-round.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status, changed by each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, SEQUENCED, BOARDING, READY, OFF-BLOCK, DEPARTED/TAKE OFF).

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; fields are marked REGULATED at EOBT-2hr (m2).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round comprising the arriving and the departing flight of the same aircraft, used to analyse the process afterwards.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, whose type and registration may be updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration, part of the consistent data fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI (m1).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update (m1).

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by IFPS, describing SOBT, aircraft, and destination data for a flight.

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: First destination data fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI (m1).

attributes.name: isRFPL
attributes.description: Whether this is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (m1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry with which the ATC Flight Plan and airport flight data must be consistent.

attributes.name: programmeReference
attributes.description: Reference of the slot programme entry the flight corresponds to (m1).

classes.name: Aerodrome
classes.definition: A departure or destination aerodrome, which may be coordinated (slot-controlled) or non-coordinated.

attributes.name: icaoCode
attributes.description: ICAO identifier of the aerodrome.

attributes.name: coordinated
attributes.description: Whether the aerodrome is coordinated; for coordinated airports the outbound flight is already known, for non-coordinated airports the flight plan initiates the outbound flight (m1).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: An abstract time quantity (a prefix such as Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, or Calculated applied to an event) that keeps every successive value with its originator and time of update.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the time quantity.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided or updated this value.

attributes.name: updateTime
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy or tolerance of this quantity, where the document specifies one.

operations.name: recordUpdate
operations.description: Appends a new value rather than overwriting the previous one, so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

classes.name: SOBT
classes.definition: Scheduled Off-Block Time, part of the consistent flight plan data (SOBT, aircraft registration, first destination) fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

classes.name: EOBT
classes.definition: Estimated Off-Block Time on the ATC Flight Plan, the reference point for milestone timings such as EOBT-3hr, EOBT-2hr and EOBT-t minutes.

classes.name: TOBT
classes.definition: Target Off-Block Time provided or updated by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, checked for consistency with the ATC Flight Plan at every milestone and confirmed before TSAT issue.

classes.name: AOBT
classes.definition: Actual Off-Block Time, the time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position, available with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ELDT
classes.definition: Estimated Landing Time, whose accuracy is particularly important since downstream decisions depend on it; stand/gate changes are not preferred after ELDT-30'.

classes.name: ALDT
classes.definition: Actual Landing Time, the time the aircraft touches down, available with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: EIBT
classes.definition: Estimated In-Block Time, computed from ELDT plus the estimated taxi-in time (EXIT), or ALDT plus EXIT after landing.

classes.name: AIBT
classes.definition: Actual In-Block Time, the time the aircraft arrives in-blocks, available with accuracy of +/- 1 minute; ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT for normal turn-rounds.

classes.name: ETOT
classes.definition: Estimated Take-Off Time, updated for a departure at ATC Flight Plan activation.

classes.name: TTOT
classes.definition: Target Take-Off Time, calculated on the basis of EIBT+MTTT+EXOT (or TOBT+EXOT when TOBT is available), monitored against an agreed tolerance before Network Operations is informed.

classes.name: CTOT
classes.definition: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations to regulated flights at EOBT-2hr.

classes.name: ATOT
classes.definition: Actual Take-Off Time, provided by ATC or ACARS at take-off from the outstation or from this airport, with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ASBT
classes.definition: Actual Start Boarding Time, the time the gate opens for physical boarding, available with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ARDT
classes.definition: Actual Ready Time, when doors are closed, boarding bridge removed and push-back vehicle connected, provided by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ASRT
classes.definition: Actual Start-up Request Time, the time start-up is requested by the pilot, available with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ASAT
classes.definition: Actual Start-up Approval Time, the time the aircraft receives its start-up approval, available with accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: TSAT
classes.definition: Target Start-Up Approval Time issued by ATC t minutes before EOBT, with locally agreed accuracy, stabilising the flight into the pre-departure sequence.

classes.name: ACGT
classes.definition: Actual Commence of Ground Handling Time, provided by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler with accuracy of +/- 1 minute, applicable to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

classes.name: EXOT
classes.definition: Estimated Taxi-Out Time, calculated by the ATC system from TOBT based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and waiting period at the holding position.

classes.name: EXIT
classes.definition: Estimated Taxi-In Time, used together with ELDT or ALDT to compute EIBT.

classes.name: MTTT
classes.definition: The (minimum/estimated) turn-round period used, together with EIBT and EXOT, to calculate TTOT and TOBT for the departing flight.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: An abstract CDM milestone event with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The event or condition that triggers this milestone's process, as stated in the document.

attributes.name: timingRule
attributes.description: The timing rule that governs when this milestone occurs.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: The effect the milestone has on flight data and downstream decisions.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to when this milestone occurs, where stated.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO ATC Flight Plan is submitted and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: sendEDPI
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI message, feeding Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data; should not be sent if information is missing or inconsistent.

operations.name: checkFlightReadyWithin15Minutes
operations.description: Checks that the flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT.

classes.name: EOBTMinus2hr
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr regulated flights receive a CTOT and estimates are checked against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: sendTDPI
operations.description: Informs Network Operations of the updated take-off time estimate using a T-DPI message at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT taking into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT; a manually input TOBT overrides this, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP), used to update landing and take-off estimates.

operations.name: checkLandingTimeConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH estimated landing times after take-off from outstation are consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about updated take-off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message when a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is exceeded.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT; if EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is available it overrules, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, triggering a TOBT update.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanged
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: computeEIBT
operations.description: Computes EIBT using ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase, updating ELDT and triggering a new TOBT.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanged
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT is recorded, triggering an update of downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given ALDT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanged
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: updateEIBT
operations.description: Updates EIBT according to ALDT + EXIT.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT is recorded, triggering an automatic or manual update of TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given AIBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanged
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: commencement of ground handling operations (ACGT), triggering a TOBT update for first-of-day or long-parked flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given ACGT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanged
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTOBT
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT, t minutes before EOBT, prior to TSAT issue.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update.

operations.name: confirmTOBT
operations.description: Performed at a predefined local time to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if manually modified before.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanged
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: Calculates the Estimated Taxi-Out Time based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and waiting period at the Holding Position.

classes.name: TSATIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time, stabilising the flight into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT issue exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded, the TOBT input is processed per local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT, checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT and informs the AO/GH if TOBT needs updating.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: doors closed, boarding bridge removed, push-back vehicle connected, ready to taxi (ARDT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfARDT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ARDT/RDY in the Airport CDM Platform, confirming the flight follows the indicated TOBT.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance, checks whether ARDT/RDY has been received and informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed if not.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time start-up is requested by the pilot (ASRT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASRT when it occurs.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestedInTime
operations.description: Alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start-up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window; the AO/GH is informed to update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: the time the aircraft receives its start-up approval (ASAT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASAT when it occurs, confirming start-up/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkASATConsistencyWithTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of AOBT when it occurs.

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or at a defined time prior to TTOT in case of remote holding.

operations.name: checkTTOTChangeExceedsTolerance
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed with a new A-DPI.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time the aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informPartnersOfATOT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: Generates an airborne message and sends FSA and MVT messages.

operations.name: removeFromDepartureSequence
operations.description: Removes the flight from the departure sequence.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated for each flight, processes all available information, and carries out the ACISP actions defined at each milestone.

operations.name: processFlightInformation
operations.description: Initiates the platform for the flight and processes all available information (m1).

operations.name: updateELDTAndEIBTForArrival
operations.description: Updates ELDT and EIBT for an arrival and ETOT for a departure (m1).

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks the appropriate fields as REGULATED and updates ETOT/TTOT/CTOT at EOBT-2hr (m2).

operations.name: updateTimingsOnProgress
operations.description: Updates ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT following take-off from outstation, local radar update, and final approach (m3,4,5).

operations.name: updateOnLanding
operations.description: Changes ELDT to ALDT and updates EIBT, TOBT and TTOT on landing (m6).

operations.name: updateOnInBlock
operations.description: Changes EIBT to AIBT and updates TOBT and TTOT on in-block (m7).

operations.name: updateOnGroundHandlingStart
operations.description: Updates ETTT/TOBT and TTOT on commencement of ground handling (m8).

operations.name: updateTTOTOnTSAT
operations.description: Updates TTOT when TSAT is issued (m10).

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: Records AOBT on off-block (m15).

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: Records ATOT on take off (m16).

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC system (e.g. A-SMGCS, Tower FDPS) that detects milestones such as landing, in-block, and take off, and provides data at the accuracy of the ATC system.

classes.name: RadarSystem
classes.definition: The radar system that detects a flight based on its assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary, range/position, or level.

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft communication system that reports ACARS timestamps (ON, IN, OUT, OFF) equivalent to ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT.

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The system by which Network Operations monitors the progress of a flight within 3 hours flying time of the destination airport.

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI) exchanged between the Airport CDM Platform and Network Operations.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message sent (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI).

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: Time the DPI message was sent.

classes.name: FUM
classes.definition: The Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations, providing updates of a flight's progress, including ATOT and ELDT information.

classes.name: MVTMessage
classes.definition: A movement message sent on take off.

classes.name: FSAMessage
classes.definition: A flight status/airborne message sent on take off.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.
